new_claim.statement: If H,L are independent and mutually independent of (P,V), with density caps m_H,m_L and ||p_V||_infinity<=K_V, then Q=2tHL+2bLP+2cLV+lambda V^2+beta L+eta V+gamma has ||p_Q||_infinity,ess <= C_*(m_L m_H K_V/|t|)^(2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3), uniformly in b,c,beta,eta,gamma, where C_*=7.761982175235... from account02/B05 QFORM-NULL-HUB-TRANSVERSE-SQUARE-v1.
new_claim.key_factor: After W=V+eta/(2lambda), S=tH+bP+cW+(beta-c eta/lambda)/2, the pair density obeys p_(S,W)(s,w)<= (m_H/|t|)p_W(w); L is independent of (S,W).
new_claim.target_valid_control: Q_b=2HL+2bLP+V^2 has spectrum {+sqrt(1+b^2),-sqrt(1+b^2),0,1} in an orthonormal (H,L,P,V) basis and density <9.780 for normalized cap-one inputs, uniformly in b.

partner_result_applied.application: Apply with independent hub=L, dependent pair=(S,W), pair cap M<=m_H K_V/|t|, square coefficient c_2=lambda.
